blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A language model can fail a syntactic test in two distinct ways: by not encoding the relevant structure, or by encoding it but failing to use it at the output. Behavioral evaluation alone cannot tell these apart. We propose a three-level evaluation framework (behavioral deployment, LM-head readout, and probe recoverability) measured on the same items under the same binary decision. Using a compact trilingual (English, Chinese, German) control-dependency benchmark, we find that probe recoverability exceeds or equals LM-head readout, which in turn exceeds or equals behavioral deployment, across seven models and all three languages in the aggregate. The recoverability surplus is never negative across all 14 (model, task) conditions. The disconnect concentrates in subject-control, where a nearest-noun heuristic gives the wrong answer. The single largest gap ( 0.653 0.653 ) appears on Qwen3-0.6B Instruct in question answering. The gap persists at Qwen3-14B Instruct. Instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms. We rule out option-position bias, late-layer erasure, output-formatting artifacts, and probe-training variance. The pattern is consistent with decoding that favors surface shortcuts, and the behavior–probe gap measures the strength of that preference. Activation patching shows the gap is layer-localized. Under instruction tuning, the LM-head-decoded layer shifts approximately ten layers later than the probe-decoded layer. These findings argue that behavioral evaluation understates what models encode, while probing alone overstates what they deploy.
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型可以通过两种不同的方式失败一个合成测试:不编码相关的结构,或编码它,但未能在输出时使用. 行为评价本身无法区分这些方面。 我们建议在同一个二进制决定下的相同物品上测量一个三级评价框架(行为部署、LM头读取和探测可回收性)。 使用紧凑的三语言(英语,汉语,德语)控制-依赖性基准,我们发现探测器的可回收性超过或等于LM-头读出,这又超过或等于行为部署,跨越七种模型和所有三种语言在集合中. 在所有14个条件(模式、任务)中,可回收性盈余从来没有负数。 断开作用集中在主题控制上,其中最近的名词heuristic给出了错误的答案. 最大的差距(0.653 0.653 )出现在Qwen3-0.6B问题回答中。 在Qune3-14B指示中,差距仍然存在。 指令调制以百分比表示比编码更能降解部署. 我们排除了选项位置偏差, 晚期的消除,输出格式化的文物, 以及探测器训练的差异。 模式符合有利于表面快捷键的解码,而行为 - 可能的差距则衡量这种偏好的力量。 激活补丁显示空隙为层局部化. 在指令调制下,LM-头-解码层比探测器-解码层晚约10层. 这些发现认为,行为评价低估了什么模型编码,而光是检测就过分地表述了它们部署的内容.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A syntactic error by a language model is ambiguous between two accounts. The structure may never have been encoded, or it was encoded and remained recoverable in the hidden states yet failed to reach the final output. Behavioral evaluation alone cannot distinguish them. Telling them apart requires measuring what the model encodes, not only what it outputs. The information is in the representation. The gap opens at the output.
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型的合成错误在两个账户之间模糊不清. 该结构可能从未编码过,或者它曾编码过,在隐藏状态中仍然可以恢复,但尚未达到最终输出. 行为评价本身无法区分它们。 要将它们分开,需要衡量模型编码的内容,而不仅仅是其产出。 资料见代表处. 间隙在输出时打开.

blocks.en: Control dependencies provide a natural testbed for this distinction. In John told Mary to leave , the understood subject of leave is Mary (object control); in John promised Mary to leave , it is John (subject control). Object-control aligns with a nearest-noun heuristic; subject-control overrides it, because the matrix subject is further from the lower predicate. Decoding by linear proximity therefore fails subject-control while answering object-control correctly.
blocks.zh: 控制依赖性为这种区别提供了一个自然的试验床。 在约翰告诉玛丽离开时,被理解的休假对象是玛丽(目标控制);在约翰答应玛丽离开时,是约翰(目标控制). 对象控制与最接近的名词heuristic对齐;对象控制会超越它,因为矩阵主体离下级上游更远. 因此,通过线性近距离解码失败了主题控制,同时正确回答对象控制.

blocks.en: To measure the encoding-deployment distinction on the same items, we propose a three-level framework. Behavioral deployment scores the correct continuation under a task-facing prompt ( Linzen et al., 2016 ; Warstadt et al., 2020 ) . LM-head readout projects intermediate hidden states through the model’s own output map (the LM head) and scores candidate continuations layer by layer ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ; Geva et al., 2021 ) . Probe recoverability reports the best accuracy a lightweight linear classifier achieves from any layer, as a ceiling on what a linear probe can recover ( Belinkov, 2022 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) . The three measurements share the same 48 hand-curated minimal pairs under the same binary decision. The levels form a logical order: behavioral deployment is the tightest floor, probe recoverability is the highest ceiling, and LM-head readout sits between them, anchored in the model’s own output geometry. That probing and behavior can disagree is not a hypothesis. Prior work has documented it empirically ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Waldis et al., 2024 ) . We ask whether the disagreement has a localizable structure consistent with a decoder that reaches for surface heuristics at the output when richer information is recoverable internally ( McCoy et al., 2019 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了衡量在相同项目上的编码部署区别,我们提出了一个三级框架。 行为部署在一个完成任务的提示下,对正确的持续进行评分(Linzen等人,2016年;Warstadt等人,2020年)。 LM-head读取项目中间隐藏状态通过模型自己的输出图(LM头),逐层评分候选续作(怀旧代数,2020年;Geva等人,2021年). 探测可回收性报告轻量级线性分类器从任何一层都达到的最佳准确性,作为线性探测器可回收物的上限(Belinkov, 2022;Hewitt and Liang, 2019). 三种测量方法在同一二进制决定下共用相同的48个手加工最小对. 水平形成逻辑顺序:行为部署是最紧的地板,探测器可回收性是最高的天花板,LM头读出在它们之间,固定在模型自己的输出几何上. 这种探险和行为可以有分歧并不是一种假设。 先前的工作以实证方式加以记录(Agarwal等人,2025年;He等人,2025年;Waldis等人,2024年)。 我们问,分歧是否具有一个可定位的结构,与一个解码器一致,该解码器在产出时,当更丰富的信息可以内部恢复时,可到达表面热量(McCoy等人,2019年;Geirhos等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: Our benchmark is 48 hand-curated minimal-pair items in English, Chinese, and German ( de Marneffe et al., 2021 ; Sanches Duran et al., 2025 ) , each in object-control and subject-control versions under question-answering and paraphrase-selection formats. The main model family is Qwen3 (0.6B base, 0.6B instruct, 14B instruct); Llama-3.2 and Gemma-4 serve as external-family checks. The three-level ordering behavior ≤ \leq LM-head ≤ \leq probe holds across all seven models and all three languages in the aggregate (Section 4 ). The effect concentrates in subject-control: the sharpest case is Qwen3-0.6B Instruct QA subject-control, behavior 0.250 against probe 0.903 (Figure 2 ). Scaling to 14B does not close the subject-control gap, and instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms. A counterbalanced-ordering ablation rules out option-position artifacts ( Shen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的基准是48个手工加工的英语、汉语和德语最小派项目(de Marneffe et al., 2021;Sanches Duran et al., 2025),每个项目在问答和参数选择格式下的物体控制和主题控制版本。 主要模式家族为Qune3(0.6B基数,0.6B指示数,14B指示数);Llama-3.2和Gemma-4作为外部家族检查. 三级命令行为 \ leq LM-head \ \ leq 探测器在所有7种模型和所有三种语言的集合中占据着位置(第4节)。 效果集中在主体控制:最尖锐的病例是Qwen3-0.6B. 指示QA主题控制,行为0.250对探测器0.903(图2 ). 缩放到14B不会缩小主题控制漏洞,指令调制比编码在百分率上更能降解部署. 逆向平衡的订货排除了选择位置的文物(沈等人,2025年).

blocks.en: We pose three research questions, each paired with a testable hypothesis: • RQ1 (consistency). Does the ordering behavior ≤ \leq LM-head readout ≤ \leq probe hold across models, languages, and control types? H1. The ordering holds in the aggregate, and the recoverability surplus concentrates in subject-control. • RQ2 (localization). Where does the subject-control deficit live: in the encoding, in the output geometry, or in deployment? H2. The deficit is a deployment deficit: probe recoverability stays high where behavioral accuracy collapses. • RQ3 (locus of change). Do scaling and instruction tuning shift the gap, and at which level? H3. Scaling to 14B closes only the object-control gap; instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms and shifts the causally relevant readout layer later.
blocks.zh: 我们提出三个研究问题,每个问题都有一个可测试的假设: • RQ1(一致性). 命令行为\ \ leq LM 头读出\\ \ leq 探测器是否在模型、语言和控制类型之间保持 ? H1 单数 订单总和不变,可回收性盈余集中在主体控制。 • RQ2(本地化)。 主体控制缺陷生活在哪里:在编码,输出几何,或部署中? H2(英语:H2). 不足是部署不足:在行为准确性崩溃时,探测器的可恢复性仍然很高。 • RQ3(变化之谜)。 缩放和指令调整是否转移了差距,在哪个级别? H3型机车. 缩放到 14B 只关闭对象控制漏洞;指令调制比编码在百分率上更能降解部署,并将因果相关的读出层移到后面.

blocks.zh: RQ3(变化的争论). 缩放和指令调整是否转移了差距,在哪个级别? H3型机车. 缩放到 14B 只关闭对象控制漏洞;指令调制比编码在百分率上更能降解部署,并将因果相关的读出层移到后面.

blocks.en: Our three-level framework triangulates the behavior–probe disconnect and localizes it at the representation-to-output interface. In syntactic control, the evidence is consistent with shortcut-preferring decoding, concentrated in subject-control, resistant to scaling, and sharpened by instruction tuning. Activation patching (Appendix G ) gives preliminary causal evidence that in instruction-tuned models the LM-head-decoded layer shifts approximately ten layers later than the probe-decoded layer. Our benchmark and ablation are reusable components; code and items are available at https://github.com/camel-luv/encoded-but-not-decoded .
blocks.zh: 我们的三层框架对行为进行三角定位 – 可能断开, 并将其定位于表达- 输出界面 。 在综合控制中,证据与快捷键优先的解码一致,集中在主体控制,抗缩放,通过指令调谐进行磨损. 激活补丁(Appendix G )提供了初步的因果证据,说明在指令调制模型中,LM-头-解码层的移动比探测器-解码层晚约10层. 我们的基准和扩展是可重复使用的组件;编码和项目可在https://github.com/camel-luv/encoded- but-not-decoded上查阅。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Two evaluation traditions for syntactic knowledge in language models have developed largely in parallel. Behavioral evaluation compares the probabilities a model assigns to matched grammatical and ungrammatical strings ( Linzen et al., 2016 ; Gulordava et al., 2018 ; Warstadt et al., 2020 ; Gauthier et al., 2020 ) . Representational probing asks what a lightweight classifier can recover from hidden states independently of behavior ( Hewitt and Manning, 2019 ; Tenney et al., 2019b ; Tenney et al., 2019a ) , and has recently been extended to LLMs to test whether hierarchical syntactic structure (e.g., the control–raising distinction) is encoded ( Kennedy, 2025 ) . Each tradition is methodologically silent on the other’s measurement. Behavioral benchmarks cannot access representations, and probing classifiers cannot validate output use. The three-level framework we propose measures both on the same items and inserts LM-head readout between them.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中综合知识的两个评价传统基本平行发展。 行为评价比较概率 一个模型指定匹配语法和非语法字符串(Linzen等人,2016年;Gulordava等人,2018年;Warstadt等人,2020年;Gauthier等人,2020年). 代表性探究者问道,轻量级的分类器能从隐藏状态中独立于行为而恢复什么(Hewitt和Manning, 2019;Tenney等人, 2019b;Tenney等人, 2019a), 并且最近被扩展至LLMs,以测试等级合成结构(如控制-提高区分)是否编码(Kennedy, 2025). 每个传统在方法上都对另一方的衡量保持沉默。 行为基准无法获取表达,而测试分类器也无法验证产出的使用. 我们提出的三个层面框架既针对同一项目提出措施,又在项目之间插入LM头读数。

blocks.en: The two traditions diverge empirically. Agarwal et al. (2025) show that syntactic probes do not reliably predict targeted syntactic evaluation outcomes; He et al. (2025) document a performance-competence distinction in which hidden states carry more information than final outputs express. Zhu et al. (2025) report a parallel effect. Internal representations encode question difficulty that behavior does not exhaust. Probing work on grammatical number makes the “recoverability-versus-usage” separation explicit within syntax. What a probe can recover from representations and what the model uses at the output are distinct quantities ( Lasri et al., 2022 ) . The Holmes benchmark extends this pattern across a broad suite of linguistic phenomena and architectures ( Waldis et al., 2024 ) . These studies document the disconnect without localizing where in the pipeline it opens or whether it varies with linguistic subtype; our three-level framework is that localization tool.
blocks.zh: 这两种传统在经验上有所不同。 Agarwal等人(2025年)表明,综合探测器无法可靠地预测有针对性的综合评价结果;He等人。 (2025)记录了一种性能-能力区分,其中隐藏状态携带的信息多于最终产出表达的信息.  Zhu等. (2025)报告有平行效果. 内部表达式编码质疑行为不会耗尽的困难. 关于语法数字的试验工作使“可恢复性与使用性”分离在语法中明确。 探测器可从表示物中回收什么,模型在输出时使用什么是不同的数量(Lasri等人,2022年)。 福尔摩斯基准将这一模式延伸至一系列广泛的语言现象和架构(Waldis等人,2024年). 这些研究记录了断开状态,而没有将它打开的管道位置定位,或者它是否与语言子类型不同;我们的三级框架就是本地化工具。

blocks.en: Probing has a known methodological vulnerability. A linear probe trained on top of frozen representations can succeed for reasons that reflect the probe’s own capacity rather than the model’s internal computation ( Belinkov, 2022 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) , and probing accuracy alone does not establish that the model uses the recovered information ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ) . LM-head readout addresses both limitations. The logit-lens tradition has established that intermediate hidden states projected through the model’s own output embedding carry interpretable layer-wise predictions ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ; Geva et al., 2021 ; Geva et al., 2022 ) . We use it to anchor the three-level comparison at the output interface. Prompt- and label-sensitivity of probing ( Shen et al., 2025 ) is handled by a counterbalanced-ordering ablation; causal-mediation analysis, causal abstraction, and activation editing replace correlational probing with intervention ( Vig et al., 2020 ; Geiger et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 调查在方法上存在众所周知的脆弱性。 接受过冷冻表达法之上的线性探测器可以成功,其原因反映探测器自身的能力,而不是模型的内部计算(Belinkov, 2022;Hewitt和Liang, 2019),而光是测试精度并不能确定模型是否使用回收的信息(Ravichander等人, 2021). LM头读出法解决了这两个局限性. 成对数传统规定,通过模型自身输出嵌入预测的中间隐藏状态带有可解释的层次预测(怀旧代数,2020年); Geva等人,2021年;Geva等人,2022年). 我们用它来锁定输出界面的三级比较. 检测的即时和标签敏感性(Shen等人,2025年)通过反平衡测序法处理;因果介导分析,因果抽象,激活编辑用干预取代相关检测(Vig等人,2020年;Geiger等人,2021年;Meng等人,2022年).

blocks.en: Control dependencies are the linguistic test case that makes this triangulation interpretable. Control is a syntax-semantics interface phenomenon. The controller of the embedded predicate is determined by the thematic structure of the matrix verb, not by linear adjacency, with both movement-based ( Hornstein, 1999 ; Boeckx and Hornstein, 2007 ) and PRO-based ( Landau, 2013 ) accounts in generative grammar. The object/subject contrast makes control productive as a diagnostic. Object-control aligns with linear proximity (the controller is the immediately preverbal noun), while subject-control overrides it. Corpus evidence shows that such surface heuristics describe much of controller resolution in natural text ( Stengel-Eskin and Van Durme, 2022 ) , which is why subject-control is the sharp place to test them. Earlier work has observed the object/subject asymmetry computationally ( de-Dios-Flores et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 控制依赖是语言测试案例,使得这种三角化可以解释. 控制是一种语法语义界面现象. 嵌入式上游的控制器由矩阵动词的主题结构决定,而不是线性附位,两者都以运动为主(Hornstein,1999年;Boeckx和Hornstein,2007年)和PRO为主(Landau,2013年)在基因语法中的账户. 对象/主体对比使控制作为一种诊断产生效果. 对象控制与线性近距离(控制器是即时前名词)对齐,而主体控制则覆盖它. 公司证据表明,这种表面heuristic在自然文本(Stengel-Eskin和Van Durme,2022年)中描述了控制器的许多分辨率,这就是为什么主体控制是测试它们的尖锐的地方. 早先的工作通过计算观察到了物体/主体不对称(de-Dios-Flores等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Three languages (English, Chinese, German) harden the empirical claim against single-language artifacts. Cross-lingual comparisons reflect more than typology. Tokenization, pretraining balance, and instruction tuning all contribute ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Goworek and Dubossarsky, 2025 ; Chirkova and Nikoulina, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 三种语言(英语,汉语,德语)对单一语言文物的实证索赔要求更加强硬. 跨语言的比较反映的不仅仅是类型。 Tokenization,预训平衡,以及教学调理等所有贡献(Hu等人,2025年;Goworek和Dubossarsky,2025年;Chirkova和Nikoulina,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark design
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准设计

blocks.en: We study control dependencies. The embedded predicate has an understood subject that is not overtly realized inside the embedded clause, and the benchmark separates object-control items, where the matrix object is the controller, from subject-control items, where the matrix subject controls (Appendix B ). This contrast drives the paper’s central result, because deployment failures concentrate in subject-control. The 48 hand-curated items split evenly across English, Chinese, and German (8 object/8 subject per language). Statistical leverage comes from minimal-pair structure rather than item count. Items within a language share their NPs and event semantics, differing only in the matrix verb’s controller assignment, and cross-condition claims aggregate over models, languages, and layers.
blocks.zh: 我们研究控制依赖。 嵌入式上游具有一个在嵌入式条款内没有明显实现的被理解的主体,基准将矩阵对象为控制器的物体控制项目与主体控制项目,矩阵主体控制(Appendix B )分离. 这一对比推动了论文的核心成果,因为部署失败集中在主题控制上。 48个手工加工物品在英语、中文和德语之间分布均匀(每个语言8个对象/8个主题)。 统计杠杆来自最小的坑道结构,而不是项目计数。 语言内的项目共享其NP和事件语义,仅在矩阵动词控制器分配上有所不同,并且跨条件索赔汇总于模型、语言和层次。

blocks.en: Each item carries two candidate controller nouns, the lower predicate, a gold controller annotation, a language label, and a control-type label. Behavior is evaluated under two task formats, question answering and paraphrase selection (Table 2 in Appendix B ), both pairwise log-probability scoring over two explicit continuations, so deployment failure is not tied to one template. For the focal Qwen models we additionally run a counterbalanced-ordering variant, averaging both candidate orderings so the result is not driven by option position (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 每件物品都带有两个候选控制器名词,下级上游,一个金色控制器注释,一个语言标签,一个控制型标签. 行为在两个任务格式下进行评估,即回答问题和解码选择(附录B表2),两者都双向对日志概率在两个明确续作中评分,因此部署失败没有绑在一个模板上. 对于Ceal Quen模型,我们额外运行一个逆向平衡排序的变体,平均两个候选人都订购,因此结果不由选项位置驱动(第4节)。

blocks.en: Item construction follows Universal Dependencies (UD) and Enhanced UD conventions ( de Marneffe et al., 2021 ; Sanches Duran et al., 2025 ) . Each item instantiates a matrix predicate with an open-clausal complement (UD xcomp ) whose embedded subject is propagated by EUD nsubj:xsubj . Object-control items lexicalize the controller as the matrix object, subject-control as the matrix subject. All matrix predicates are attested with xcomp in standard UD treebanks (English EWT, German HDT, Chinese GSDSimp).

blocks.en: If the deployment failure were a capacity limitation of small models, a strong 14B model should close the behavior–probe gap. It does for object-control. It does not for subject-control. On object-control paraphrase, Qwen3-14B Instruct reaches behavior 0.958 against probe 1.000 (gap 0.042, behavior at ceiling). On subject-control paraphrase, the same model reaches 0.583 against probe 1.000 (gap 0.417). The probe recovers the assignment perfectly from hidden states the model uses to answer with less-than-60% accuracy. Qwen3-14B Instruct is not weaker in representation but in deployment, and only on the control type that contradicts linear adjacency.
blocks.zh: 如果部署失败是小模型的能力限制,那么一个强大的14B模型应该会关闭行为-可能的差距. 这对控制物体有帮助。 它不是为了控制对象。 在对象控制参数上, Quen3-14B 指令达到行为0.958对1.000探测器(gap 0.042,行为在天花板). 在主题控制参数中,同一型号在探测器1.000(gap 0.417)下达到0.583. 探测器从隐藏中完全恢复了任务 说明模型用来回答的准确度低于60% Quen3-14B (中文(简体) ). 指令在表述上并不弱,在部署上也不弱,只针对与线性接力相矛盾的控制类型.

blocks.en: The type-level breakdown across the focal Qwen models (Figure 5 ; full numbers in Appendix I ) makes the asymmetry quantitative. The object-control gap shrinks with scale and approaches zero at 14B, while the subject-control gap does not shrink. This answers RQ2 and completes the scaling half of RQ3. Scaling raises object-control deployment to ceiling but leaves the subject-control deficit open.
blocks.zh: 跨焦质文模型的类型级分解(图5;附录一中的全数)使得不对称的定量. 对象控制差距随尺度缩小,在14B接近0,而主体控制差距并不缩小. 这解答了RQ2,并完成了RQ3的缩放一半. 缩放将对象控制部署提升到上限,但使对象控制赤字保持开放.

blocks.en: 4.5 Instruction tuning and the deployment gap
blocks.zh: 4.5 指令调整和部署差距

blocks.en: If instruction tuning had erased controller information, LM-head accuracy would collapse toward behavior. It does not. Instructed Qwen3-0.6B projects hidden states through its own output embedding and recovers the correct controller on 66.7 % 66.7\% of items, while task-facing behavior reaches only 51.0 % 51.0\% on the same items. The middle level separates “less encoded” from “less deployed.” Activation patching (Appendix G ) sharpens this. In base models the layer where patching causally rescues controller assignment coincides with the probe-decoded layer, while in instruction-tuned models it shifts approximately ten layers later. This addresses the instruction-tuning half of RQ3. The gap shifts because deployment degrades more than encoding, not because encoding collapses.
blocks.zh: 如果指令调音删除了控制器信息,LM头的准确性就会向行为崩溃. 它没有。 指示 Qune3-0.6B 工程通过自己的输出嵌入来隐藏状态,并在66.7%的66.7QQ项目上恢复正确的控制器,而任务完成行为在同一项目上只达到51.0% 51.0QQ. 中层将“无编码”与“部署不足”。 激活补丁(Appendix G )使这个更加清晰. 在基准模型中,补丁因果救护控制器分配的层与探测器解码层重合,而在指令调制模型中,它大约在10层后移动. 这解决了RQ3的指令调整问题。 由于部署比编码更能降解,而不是因为编码崩溃,所以漏洞会转移.

The surplus compression amplifies with scale.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The three-level framework turns an empirical complaint into a localized diagnosis. Prior work has documented behavior–probe disagreement ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Waldis et al., 2024 ) . Our contribution is to show that inserting LM-head readout as an intermediate measurement gives the gap structure. The standard probing objection—that linear probes can extract information the model itself cannot use ( Belinkov, 2022 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) —does not apply to LM-head readout, which uses the model’s own output projection instead of a trained classifier ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ; Geva et al., 2021 ) . At 14B, behavior and LM-head coincide at 0.792 0.792 while the probe reaches 1.000 1.000 , so neither gap is an artifact of probe capacity or task format. Four observations point in the same direction. Ordering holds across seven models and three languages, deployment loss under instruction tuning is disproportionate, the failure concentrates in subject-control, and the deficit persists at 14B. The final decoding step selectively fails to use controller information the model both encodes and can project through its own output geometry.
blocks.zh: 三级框架将实证投诉转化为局部诊断. 先前的工作记录了行为 - 可能存在分歧(Agarwal等人,2025年;He等人,2025年;Waldis等人,2024年)。 我们的贡献是表明,将LM-头读出作为中间度量法使差距结构产生。 标准测试反对意见——线性探测器可以提取模型本身不能使用的信息(Belinkov, 2022;Hewitt and Liang, 2019)——不适用于LM-head读出,它使用模型自己的输出投影而不是经过训练的分类器(Nostalgebraist, 2020;Geva等人, 2021). 在14B时,行为和LM-head重合为0.792 0.792,而探测器则达到1000 1.000,因此两个缺口都不是探测能力或任务格式的文物. 四种观察指向同一方向. 定购持有7种型号和3种语言,指令调谐下的部署损失不成比例,故障集中在主体控制,赤字持续在14B. 最终的解码步骤选择性地未能使用控制器信息,该模型既无法编码,也能通过自己的输出几何投影.

blocks.en: Late-layer erasure and output-format artifacts are the two cleanest alternative accounts, and Results § 4.3 rules out either as a complete account. Probe recoverability stays high through the final layers, debiased behavioral accuracy stays well below the LM-head peak, and a task-free third prompt preserves the ordering on five of seven models. A mixed account remains plausible. Later representations become less reliably controller-aligned, and the final decoding step amplifies the residual mismatch rather than smoothing it. Neither process alone is sufficient.
blocks.zh: 晚期消除和产出格式的文物是两个最干净的替代账户,结果第4.3节排除了作为完整账户。 探测器的可回收性通过最后的层保持高,去偏差的行为精度保持在LM-头峰以下,无任务的第三个迅速保留了七个模型中的五个模型的订单. 一个混合的说法仍然是可信的。 后期的表达方式变得不可靠控制器-对齐,最终的解码步骤放大了剩余不匹配而非平滑. 单靠两个进程都是不够的。

blocks.en: Subject-control is the control type whose correct resolution actively contradicts linear proximity. A nearest-noun heuristic gets object-control right and subject-control wrong. This matches the shortcut-learning phenomenon, where models rely on surface heuristics at the output even when richer information is linearly recoverable from their representations ( McCoy et al., 2019 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . Control thus provides a built-in contrast. Within one construction family, the heuristic succeeds on one subtype and fails on the other.
blocks.zh: 主体控制(object-control)是控制类型,其正确分辨率积极与线性近似相矛盾. 最近的名词heuristic得到对象控制正确和对象控制错误. 这与捷径学习现象相吻合,即模型在输出时,即使更丰富的信息可以从它们的表示中线性地恢复(McCoy等人,2019年;Geirhos等人,2020年)。 因此,控制提供了内在对比。 在一个建筑家族中,heuristic在一种子类型上成功,在另一种类型上失败.

blocks.en: Three independent observations are consistent with this interpretation. At 14B, the subject-control probe ceiling is perfect while behavior on the same items remains far lower, so representational capacity is not the bottleneck. Instruction tuning degrades deployment more than encoding in percentage terms, so the degradation does not target the representation itself. The failure concentrates in the subtype where the heuristic is wrong. This is the pattern a decoder reaching for the shortcut would produce.
blocks.zh: 三项独立意见与本解释一致. 在14B时,主体控制探测器的天花板是完美的,而在同一物品上的行为仍然很低,因此代表能力不是瓶颈. 指令调制在比例上比编码更能降解部署,因此降解并不针对表示本身. 失败集中在Heuristic错误的子类型中. 这是快捷键的解码器将产生的模式。

blocks.en: Gemma-4 E4B is the only model whose architecture most plausibly trains intermediate layers to remain compatible with the unembedding map (Per-Layer Embeddings, Section 3 ). This gives its near-zero surplus ( + 0.042 +0.042 , LM-head 0.604 ≈ 0.604\approx probe 0.604 0.604 ) two compatible interpretations. Under the boundary interpretation adopted in Section 4.2 , the model differs on several architectural axes at once, the framework does not apply cleanly, and the near-zero gap carries no evidence either way. Under the stronger interpretation, Gemma-4 is the one model in which the raw-diagnostic precondition is closest to being satisfied, so its LM-head readout is the most trustworthy in the study, and the deficit is smallest exactly there. That pattern would support the geometric account of the gap. Our evidence does not separate the two interpretations, so we present both and rest the framework’s cross-family claims on Qwen3 and Llama-3.2.
blocks.zh: Gemma-4 E4B是唯一一个其架构最能巧妙地训练中间层以保持与未嵌入图兼容的模型(Per-Layer Embeddings,第3节. 这使得其近零盈余(+0.042+0.042,LM-head 0.604 → 0.604\ 近似探测器 0.604 0.604)两种相容的解释. 根据第4.2节采用的边界解释,模型一次在几个建筑轴上有所不同,框架没有被干净地应用,近零差距也没有任何证据。 在更强的解释下,Gemma-4是原始诊断前提条件最接近满足的模型,因此其LM头读出是研究中最值得信赖的,而其中的缺陷正好最小. 这一模式将支持差距的几何描述。 我们的证据并没有将两种解释分开,因此我们既提出框架的跨家庭索赔,又提出Qune3和Llama-3.2。

blocks.en: The 1.000 1.000 subject-control probe ceiling could reflect genuine encoding or verb-identity leakage. A verb-out cross-validation control (Appendix H ) holds out each matrix verb and re-trains the probe on the remaining items. At 14B the subject-control probe ceiling generalizes cleanly across held-out verbs. The probe reads the control relation itself rather than memorizing verb identity. The six smaller models show probe-peak gaps deep in the leakage-dominant range. Their ceilings depend on verb identity. Object-control passes verb-out cleanly in every model. The three-level ordering still holds, but the content of its highest level shifts with scale on subject-control. At small scale the highest level is a verb-specific surface readout. At 14B it is a verb-invariant relational encoding. The “encoded but not decoded” interpretation of the gap is clean for subject-control at 14B and diluted below it by lexical leakage.
blocks.zh: 1.000 1.000主题控制探测器天花板可以反映真实的编码或动词识别泄漏. 一个动词输出的交叉验证控制(Appendix H )将每个矩阵动词牵出,并在剩余项目上重新追踪探测器. 在14时B, 主体控制探测器天花板 清洁地跨越被搁置的动词。 探测器读取控制关系本身,而不是记忆动词身份. 6个较小的模型显示在渗漏-支配范围有很深的探针-峰隙. 他们的天花板取决于动词身份. 对象控制在每一个型号中都干净地通过动词输出. 三级订单仍然维持,但其最高一级的内容随着标的控制的尺度而变化. 在小尺度上,最高水平是一个动词特有的表面读出. 在14B时,它是一个动词-不变量关系编码. 对空隙的“编码但非解码”解释在14B时对控制对象是干净的,在14B下被词典渗漏稀释。

blocks.en: Activation patching across layers (Appendix G ) locates the gap more precisely than the shortcut account alone. In base models, patching restores controller assignment most effectively at the layer where the probe reads it out. In instruction-tuned models, that effective layer sits ten layers later. Linear steering along the probe-identified direction has no effect, while patching at the shifted layer restores QA subject-control by + 0.37 +0.37 . Controller information survives instruction tuning as a linear, probe-readable direction. What moves is the layer at which the output can use it. This account accords with mechanistic studies of instruction tuning. Distributional shifts under alignment concentrate in surface-level outputs ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , and fine-tuning enhances rather than rewires existing mechanisms ( Prakash et al., 2024 ) . Whether the surplus compression observed in the other pairs (Results § 4.5 ) arises through the same layer shift remains untested.
blocks.zh: 跨层的激活补丁(Appendix G )比快捷键账户更准确地定位缺口. 在基准模型中,补丁在探测器读出时的图层中恢复控制器分配最为有效. 在教学调节模型中,有效层在10层后坐落. 沿探测器识别方向的线性转向没有效果,而在转向层的补丁则通过+0.37+0.37恢复QA对象控制. 控制器信息能作为线性,可探测可读方向的指令调试存活下来. 移动的是输出可以使用的图层. 这一说法与教学调整的机械学研究相一致。 调整后的分布性转移集中于地表水平输出(Lin等人,2024年),微调增强而不是重联现有机制(Prakash等人,2024年)。 其他对子(Results §4.5)中观察到的剩余压缩是否通过同一层移位产生,仍未测试.

blocks.en: Behavior-only and probe-only evaluation, often framed as separate windows on form-meaning relations ( Bender and Koller, 2020 ) , measure different interfaces to whatever the model encodes. LM-head readout is the missing third measurement, turning the behavior–probe gap into a localized diagnosis. The heterogeneous effects of instruction tuning across model pairs (Results § 4.5 ) become visible only when the three levels are measured separately. Behavior-only or probe-only evaluation would collapse them into a single score.
blocks.zh: 行为唯和探针唯评价,常在形式意思关系上被设定为单独的窗口(Bender and Koller, 2020),对模型编码的任意,测量不同的界面. LM-head读取是缺失的第三项测量,将行为-可能的差距转化为局部诊断. 只有当对三个级别分别进行测量时,才能看出跨模型对的指令调值(Results §4.5)所产生的各种效应。 只有行为或只有探测器的评价 才能让他们崩溃成单一的分数

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Syntactic evaluation in language models should not equate behavioral failure with the absence of structural information. Encoding, readout, and deployment diverge in a stable order across all seven models and all three languages.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的协同评价不应将行为失败与缺乏结构信息等同起来. 编码、读出和部署在所有7种模式和所有3种语言之间稳定地顺序不同。

blocks.en: We propose a three-level evaluation framework, which employs behavioral deployment, LM-head readout, and probe recoverability on identical binary decisions, addressing the gap between what a model encodes and what it deploys. These results confirm that the information is in the representation, yet the gap opens at the output. The three-level framework shows that instruction tuning can reshape deployment, not encoding.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个三级评价框架,采用行为部署,LM头读取,并用相同的二进制决定来探索可回收性,解决模型编码与其部署之间的差距。 这些结果证实,信息在表述中,但产出中差距拉开。 三级框架显示指令调制可以重塑部署,而不是编码.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The benchmark is 48 hand-curated items across English, Chinese, and German, evenly split between object-control and subject-control. It is designed for targeted diagnosis. Template-generated syntax benchmarks such as BLiMP maximize coverage with tens of thousands of items ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) ; this set is the deliberate trade-off, because it holds item identity fixed across the three measurement levels and three languages.
blocks.zh: 基准为48个手工加工项目,跨越英语,中文,德语,均匀划分对象控制与主体控制. 它旨在进行有针对性的诊断。 模板生成的语法基准,如BLIMP以数万项(Warstadt等人,2020年)的覆盖范围最大化;本集是刻意权衡的,因为它拥有跨越三个计量级别和三种语言的固定项目身份.

blocks.en: Raw cross-language differences partly reflect tokenization and pretraining exposure rather than typological variation. EUD’s explicit nsubj:xsubj propagation is annotated for English but not for Chinese or German, so the controller relation in non-English items is lexically determined by matrix-verb semantics. Cross-condition claims rest on more than the 48 items. The layer-sweep analyses (Appendix G ) span over 10,000 10{,}000 patched (model, layer, item) observations, and the structural contrast (subject-control gap larger than object-control gap) replicates independently across 7 models, 3 languages, and 4 (task, control-type) cells.
blocks.zh: 原始的跨语言差异部分反映了象征性的和预先训练的接触,而不是类型变化。 EUD的明文 nsubj:xsubj 传播被附加英文说明,但中文或德文没有说明,因此非英文项目中控制器关系由矩阵动词语义法决定. 超过48项的交叉条件索赔。 层扫荡分析(Appendix G)跨度超过10,000 10{,}000个补丁(模型,层,项)观测,结构对比(主体控制差距大于对象控制差距)跨7个模型,3种语言,4个(任务,控制类型)细胞独立复制.

blocks.en: The mechanistic evidence is concentrated in the Qwen3 family, where the 0.6B base/instruct pair shows the effect most sharply and Qwen3-14B Instruct rules out a capacity-based interpretation. Llama-3.2 replicates the ordering in an independent family with the complementary degradation profile (§ 4.2 ). Cross-family evidence rests on two text families, with Gemma-4 contributing an architectural contrast rather than a third replication; we do not generalize the framework to that architecture class without further evidence. The scaling extensions (Qwen3-1.7B, Llama-3.2-3B) contribute surplus-compression evidence (Results § 4.5 ) but no mechanistic data.
blocks.zh: 机械证据集中在Qwen3家族,其中0.6B基/指令对显示效果最尖锐,Quen3-14B. 指示排除基于能力的解释. Llama-3.2在具有辅助降解特征的独立家庭中复制订单(第4.2节)。 跨家庭的证据基于两个文本家庭,Gemma-4提供了一种建筑对比,而不是第三次复制;我们没有在没有进一步证据的情况下将框架概括到这一建筑类。 缩放扩展(Quen3–1.7B,Llama–3.2–3B)提供盈余压缩证据(Results §4.5),但没有机械数据.

blocks.en: Probe recoverability uses linear probes. Nonlinear probes might raise the ceiling without changing the gap direction. LM-head readout assumes the output projection as a fixed map, clean for tied-embedding models and less so otherwise. The counterbalanced-ordering ablation addresses option-position bias but not other prompt-sensitivity effects. Activation patching (Appendix G ) uses single-layer patches, so we report layer-localization rather than head-level attribution.

blocks.en: The probe summary is an upper bound on what a linear decoder can extract from the most informative layer. blocks.en: The behavior–probe gap admits two interpretations. The LM head fails to deploy controller information that is geometrically present at the probed layer, or the probe identifies geometry that correlates with controller identity but is not the geometry the LM head actually uses. We test both interpretations with two interventions on the residual stream: directional steering (additive perturbation along a probe-derived direction, the amnesic-probing logic of removing probed information and checking the behavioral consequence ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) ) and activation patching ( Vig et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) (replacement of one item’s hidden state with another’s). Directional steering produces no behavioral change at any tested magnitude, while activation patching reveals a layer-localized causal effect that differs systematically between base and instruction-tuned models.

blocks.en: Linear additive steering is null because the probe-recoverable direction is not the direction the LM head decodes from. Activation patching peaks at the probe layer in base models and ten layers later in instruction-tuned models, identifying a discrete shift in which layer carries the LM-head-decoded form of the controller geometry . Taken together, the residual stream encodes controller information at a layer decodable both by a probe and by the LM head in base models. Instruction tuning displaces the LM-head-decoded form to later layers, leaving an intermediate window in which the information is recoverable by probing but not yet usable by output generation. The behavior–probe gap quantified in Section 4 is the behavioral cost of this displacement. Our results provide a layer-localized empirical instance of the long-standing concern that probe-recoverable directions need not be causally identical to the directions the LM head decodes from ( Belinkov, 2022 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) , and they extend that concern from a general methodological warning into a concrete, controllable layer-shift phenomenon tied to instruction tuning.

blocks.en: The patching lifts at the late peak ( + 0.37 +0.37 at Qwen3-0.6B Instruct L26 QA subject; + 0.19 +0.19 at Qwen3-14B Instruct L27 QA subject) are substantial but below ceiling. Multi-layer simultaneous patching, finer attribution to attention heads or MLP outputs, and a denser layer grid around the late peak remain as immediate causal extensions. The present results establish layer-localization of the deployment gap and its instruction-tuning dependence.

blocks.en: Two things could inflate the Qwen3-14B Instruct subject-control probe ceiling of 1.000 1.000 above what genuine encoding of controller information would produce. First, the matrix predicates of the subject-control set cluster. German uses one verb ( versprach × 8 \times 8 ), English splits between promised × 4 \times 4 and four singletons, and Chinese splits among three verbs. Second, given this clustering, a probe could in principle achieve 1.000 1.000 by memorizing a verb-identity-to-controller mapping — without the model itself representing control as a syntactic relation. We test this leakage hypothesis directly with Verb-Out Cross-Validation (VO-CV).

blocks.en: Two design choices matter. First, training pools mix subject- and object-control examples. The probe must learn a non-trivial decision boundary and predictions are aggregated by control type after the probe is fitted. Filtering by control type before training would produce a homogeneous label set that any probe trivially solves at 1.000 1.000 even at layer 0, masking rather than testing the leakage hypothesis. Second, because the German subject-control set uses a single matrix verb, holding out versprachremoves all eight German subject-control items from training simultaneously, so the probe must classify them purely from English and Chinese subject-control plus all object-control evidence. The protocol thus subsumes a strong cross-language generalization test that single-language verb-out CV cannot provide.
